techDelivery: React + Tailwind CSS component spec (Tailwind utility classes with arbitrary values for spacing/colors, HTML5 <video> background, lucide-style icons); exact bundler/font-loading mechanism not pinned in the prompt beyond 'load and use' the four Google-style web fonts.
reskinNotes: The prompt declares FOUR typefaces but the skin schema only exposes display/body/mono/accent: display=Instrument Serif (headline), body=Inter (subtext), accent=Manrope (the persistent nav + Sign In/Get Started UI sans, Medium/Semibold 14px); Cabin (Medium 14-16px) is the FOURTH face used for the tagline pill and the two hero CTA labels and could not be slotted into a role, so reskinners must map both Manrope (nav/buttons) and Cabin (pill/CTAs) to brand UI faces. Several neutral non-brand hexes are baked into inline Tailwind classes and not surfaced as color roles: Sign In button uses white bg with a #d4d4d4 gray border and #171717 black text, Get Started uses #fafafa white text, hero CTA2 uses #f6f7f9 off-white text on the #2b2344 dark-purple bg. There is no solid page background (the video is the backdrop) so bg is set to the secondary dark-purple #2b2344, which doubles as accent2/CTA2 fill; the mobile menu overlay is solid black, distinct from bg. The glassmorphism pill (surface rgba(85,80,110,0.4) + backdrop-blur + border rgba(164,132,215,0.5)) depends on backdrop-filter. The logo is a placeholder inline SVG path filled white (no real mark yet). The headline emphasizes the word 'and' in italic with bespoke spacing and is sized 5xl→96px with line-height 1.1, so it is moderately Instrument-Serif-metric-dependent. All copy (nav labels, button labels, the 'New' badge + 'Say Hello to Datacore v3.2' pill text, the 'Book your perfect stay instantly and hassle-free' headline, the subtext, and both CTA labels) is hardcoded in markup and must be edited in code.
